newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura paid ex-racketeer 70 mln yen, Sakamaki says.
newsitem.headline: Nomura paid ex-racketeer 70 mln yen, Sakamaki says.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd paid more than 70 million yen via stock deals into accounts linked to a former racketeer, the securities firm's ex-president Hideo Sakamaki said on Tuesday.
Sakamaki said that internal Nomura investigations had discovered a total of five illegal stock deals through which the money was transferred to the accounts.
Sakamaki, who stepped down to take responsibility for the payoff scandal last month, was testifying before the budget committee of the Upper House of parliament, which is looking into the affair.
